name: Yamasaki Midori
source:
Shuuya's step mother.

When it comes to sex, it is no exaggeration to say that she loves it. However, that does not mean that she has sex with just anyone.

She may seem easygoing and childish but being a former nanny, her housework skills are perfect, and at night she can be very erotic. She also has a strong maternal instinct, and when she sees someone in trouble, she can't leave them alone.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=203321&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
